note: Twelve editorial criteria totaling 100 points. Score only supplied evidence, mark unavailable sections unassessed, and do not present this as an official LinkedIn score or hiring predictor.

items.full_marks: States the user's current professional direction, relevant background, and intended audience with evidence; it does not imply an unsupported role or experience. Verify the current character limit before scoring it.

The opening makes the user's professional direction and strongest relevant evidence clear. Avoid generic claims and third-person biography. Verify current interface behavior before asserting what is visible before 'see more'.

Addresses the intended audience, explains relevant experience and user-confirmed motivation, includes only verified evidence, and gives a next step. Verify current character limits before scoring length.
Relevant work samples or projects, a useful professional post or document, and a clear contact route; keep items accurate and current.
If the user chooses to use a banner, it supports their positioning and is comfortable to make public; visual treatment is subjective.
A clear, current and recognizable photo that the user is comfortable using professionally; image style is subjective.
One clear line of scope and two to three evidence-based bullets. Use numbers only when verified; distinguish duties from documented outcomes.
Recent and relevant roles explain scope and transferable skills. Condense earlier experience when it does not support the target role.
Prioritized skills match the user's goals and are supported by experience or project evidence. Do not list skills whose level is unclear.
Recommendations, if available, provide specific examples of collaboration or outcomes. Do not treat a particular count or age as a universal requirement.
Recent activity, if present, is relevant to the target role and reflects the user's actual views. Posting frequency is not a required score criterion.
The profile offers a current, appropriate way to make professional contact. Check current LinkedIn profile fields before giving platform-specific requirements.
